question: What claim about instruction requires the speaker to declare the method of names for them and to command the beautiful-eyed one to hear?
premises: A method concerning the names of those beings is to be stated.
The recipient is commanded to hear it.
inference: The speaker will declare the method of their names; the beautiful-eyed one is to hear it.
plain_english: I shall speak the method of their names; hear it, O beautiful-eyed one.
